name: fathi_s43_repro_p20
paper_target: Fathi et al. (2015), Section 4.3, Figs. 17-21, pure three-layer medium without inclusion

sem3d_mapping.note: The equivalence of SEM3D Apow to the paper's alpha0/beta0 notation is not proven.

time_integration.execution_guard: dt=1e-3 was empirically validated on the true layered model through the full p20 T=0.45 s interval.

source.discrete_rhs_requirement: For each resolved traction footprint, assemble f_a,z(t) = integral_Gamma N_a * 1000 Pa * f(t) dGamma with surface Jacobian and quadratic LGL weights.

forward_operator.source_operator_invariant: TRUE, parent and candidate forwards must use the same 3249 weighted Q2/LGL source entries, 3249 receivers, p20 STF, dt=0.5 ms and T=0.52 s.

time_scheme.runtime_method_deviation: SEM3D runtime ignores requested alpha/beta/gamma and reports alpha=0.5 beta=0.5 gamma=1

strict_full_grid.generation_note: Generated deterministically from this specification by the strict-forward preparation stage; no historical workspace template is a runtime dependency.
strict_full_grid.iteration_order: z outer, y middle, x inner (x changes fastest)

strict_full_grid_provenance.reason: Full-grid stations are used for forward/adjoint gradient sampling. The S43 mesh/control geometry is unchanged.
